split_construction: S01 structural pilot forced into train; seeded permutation of 2..52, first29 train, next10 development, remaining12 confirmation
preprocessing: independent original 7s trial; select fixed8; subtract first sample causally; eight-channel common average; causal FIR upfirdn 125/256 retaining 0.04s delay; existing CausalEEGFilter 50Hz notch plus1-45Hz; fourth-order causal band filters; actual stored event index determines task window
classifier: train-only StandardScaler and LDA lsqr shrinkage auto; no hyperparameter sweep
bad_trial_policy: retain every participant and every finite complete trial in primary condition; keep author's voltage/EMG flags for separately labeled diagnostic, never silently select clean/high-scoring people

personal_calibration.selection: select method by mean later-trial BA of train participants; evaluate once on development participants

confirmation_rule: only if respective development gate passes; lock one selected method before extracting confirmation participants; no retuning or second confirmation attempt
limitations: eight-channel CAR differs from author's64-channel CAR
supplied trial ordering does not provide verified run labels
no real Cyton MI/idle accuracy or live service validation
